int_name: N FRONT ST & RISING SUN AVE

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks on side streets. However, the long crossing distance across the main thoroughfare and lack of mid-block refuges or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility 'continental' style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and ADA-compliant curb ramps, but lacks active traffic control like stop signs. A parked van significantly obstructs sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A white van is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street at the intersection

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any regulatory signage or signals to manage vehicle right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Signage
interventions.description: Install a stop sign or pedestrian crossing warning signs to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide sidewalk in front of commercial buildings, but it is significantly compromised by a lack of crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the immediate corner, and a utility pole creates a physical obstruction in the middle of the walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is positioned in the center of the sidewalk, significantly narrowing the clear path for pedestrians and those using mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left, on the sidewalk in front of the pharmacy.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection corner lacks marked crosswalks, increasing the risk for pedestrians crossing the multi-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right, where the sidewalk meets the street corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There is no sloped transition from the sidewalk to the street level, creating a physical barrier for accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corner to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Maintenance
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole or widen the sidewalk to maintain a minimum 5-foot clear path for pedestrian travel.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk at a signalized junction. However, the environment lacks traffic calming measures and visible pedestrian-specific signals, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic across a relatively wide roadway.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection crossing the main road

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-specific signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line crosswalk to continental or ladder markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide better information for crossing safely.
